text.en: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) district office in San Jose City, Province of Nueva Ecija is hereby upgraded into a Class B district office.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the upgrading of the LTO district office in San Jose City, Province of Nueva Ecija, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) district office in San Jose City. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the continued operation of the upgraded San Jose City LTO District Office shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
